@@info: Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
equalizer_autoeq_exact_match_hint: Fits the curve's full shape up to 20 kHz, as the graph shows it.
equalizer_autoeq_treble_safe_hint: Smooths the treble and places no filter above 10 kHz, where measurements shift with fit and anatomy.
equalizer_autoeq_fallback_notice: The turboEQ optimizer could not be loaded, so a slower fallback fitted these filters. The ‘Auto Apply’ feature has been disabled due to its low performance.
equalizer_autoeq_fallback_rejected_notic: The turboEQ optimizer couldn't fit these settings, so a slower fallback fitted these filters.
equalizer_autoeq_graphic_unavailable_not: AutoEQ for a graphic EQ needs the turboEQ optimizer, which couldn't load. Filters are unchanged.
equalizer_autoeq_graphic_rejected_notice: The turboEQ optimizer couldn't fit this preset's bands. Filters are unchanged.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_hint: Re-runs AutoEQ whenever the curves or options change. Editing the filters turns it off.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_edit: Auto-apply turned off because the filters were edited.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_inpu: Auto-apply turned off because the device or target changed.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_pres: Auto-apply turned off because the EQ preset changed.
eq_constraint_select_title: EQ constraint preset — limits bands, filter types, and frequency / Q / gain ranges
